log_dir.description: Directory where process monitor log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the log file (relative to log_dir).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL).

transport_url.description: Message broker URL for RPC communication with OpenStack services.

process_monitor_config_file.description: Path to an optional external process monitor configuration file (for advanced setups).

enabled.description: Enable or disable the process monitor service globally.

check_interval.description: Number of seconds between checks for monitored processes.

failure_threshold.description: Number of consecutive failed checks before triggering recovery.

recovery_method.description: Recovery action: 'restart' (restart process), 'reboot_host' (reboot the node), or 'failover_host' (trigger VM HA failover).

host_name.description: Explicit hostname for this node; leave blank to auto-detect. Required if DNS/hostname resolution is unreliable.

enable_auto_recovery.description: Whether to automatically restart a failed process (only effective when recovery_method is 'restart').

monitored_processes.description: List of processes to monitor. Each entry defines the name, whether it's monitored, the command pattern (regex), PID file (if any), and per-process recovery settings.

name.description: Unique identifier for the process section.

command_pattern.description: Regular expression or exact command name to match in process list (e.g., 'libvirtd', '^/usr/bin/qemu-system.*').

pid_file.description: Optional path to a PID file; used to verify process health if reliable.

recovery_method.description: Override global recovery method for this process. If empty, inherits from [process_monitor].

failure_threshold.description: Override global failure threshold for this process. If 0, inherits from [process_monitor].
